headline: OpenAI expects its yearly sales pace to reach at least $70 billion by the end of 2026, up from about $50 billion now, Bloomberg reports.
score_reason: Keeps the pool score: a forward-looking figure from anonymous sources, useful but unconfirmed by the company.
importance_line: The target gives investors in OpenAI's coming $30 billion-plus fundraising a number to measure growth against, but it is a company projection from unnamed sources, and the sharp market reaction shows how sensitive AI shares are to these figures.
summary: Bloomberg reports, citing people familiar with the matter, that OpenAI expects to reach or exceed $70 billion in annualised revenue (recent sales scaled up to a full year) by the end of 2026, driven mainly by its business customers, after reaching about $50 billion at the end of September. OpenAI shared the figures with investors as it seeks $30 billion or more at a $1.4 trillion valuation before the new money.
notes: Bloomberg page blocked; Bloomberg text read on Yahoo Finance and a Seeking Alpha summary on TradingView. Anonymous sources; OpenAI has not published the figure.
